\noindent{\footnotesize{The engine flags a collision (gap $\leq 0$) and continues the motion; nothing is removed. Collision-free: no vehicle of the platoon collides over the whole time line. First collision: time of the first collision of any vehicle, median [10\%, 90\%] over the colliding rollouts, from the start of the time line (the first 30~s are the constant-speed burn-in). Survivors: the CRPS over the rollouts in which neither the scored vehicle nor one ahead of it collided, a survivor-biased score, with the share of rollouts kept.}}
